allowed_actions: read public GitHub objects at exact commit/path
independently verify receiver principal and rehash source bytes
perform negative mutation in isolated local copy
publish public-safe receipt on PR185 only if existing distinct-account permission is verified
prohibited_actions: create new GitHub actor, permission, App, PAT or branch
use owner account or producer token to impersonate external receiver
manually transfer source packages via Operator
push code or write to Hostinger, WWW, rulesets, PR merge or Native App R3

mission.question: Can a distinct independently authenticated external GitHub principal fetch and rehash the exact source objects and submit a verifiable public-safe ACK through an already-authorized GitHub return surface?
deliverables: identity proof by authenticated GitHub principal ID without disclosing secrets
source-exact independent SHA256/bytes for each pinned input
local one-byte mutation negative control FAIL_EXPECTED
public-safe PR185 comment witness if already permitted, otherwise explicit scoped HOLD
falsifiers: same GitHub principal as Cursor owner / producer
fetched byte count or SHA256 differs from immutable pinned source
no existing authenticated GitHub comment permission
acceptance_tests: all required source commits and paths independently fetched
independent receiver SHA256 equals expected digest for each tested source
GitHub comment author identity matches distinct independently authenticated receiver, if comment submitted
AXIOM rehash and separate adjudication still required
pause_conditions: private or unlicensed source proposed for public return
not_executed: no code branch writes or receiver write slot grants
no Native App R3 or Hostinger/WWW deploy

drift_triggers: claimed receiver identity equals GitHub owner
missing or mismatched original source SHA256
unauthorized GitHub write or private upload
false terminal ACK based on synthetic or sender evidence

functionality_performance: distinct authenticated GitHub principal self-fetches with zero Operator file transfer
robustness_stability: one-byte local negative mutation yields hash mismatch
missing actor or comment permission gives a scoped fail-closed HOLD
traceability_comprehensibility: single immutable source DAG pin with predecessor
explicit SYNTHETIC_NOT_EXTERNAL versus real receiver claim
approved external PR185 comment route separate from internal issue93 bridge contract
